old_caption: The video captures a mesmerizing scene featuring a Buddha statue at its center, set against a dark background. Surrounding the Buddha is a large, iridescent bubble that dominates the frame. The bubble's surface is highly reflective, displaying a vibrant array of colors including blues, greens, purples, and pinks, which shift and change as the bubble moves. The light refracts through the bubble, creating a dynamic and ever-changing pattern of colors that dance across the surface. The Buddha statue remains stationary throughout the video, serving as a serene focal point amidst the colorful, fluid motion of the bubble. The overall effect is one of tranquility and wonder, as the interplay of light and color within the bubble creates a captivating visual experience.

caption: The video captures a glowing cyan Buddha head statue centered below, framed by an arch-shaped opening in an iridescent soap-film dome against black. The dome fills the upper frame with shifting rainbow interference colors, a bright blue-green arc along its top, magenta and purple bands around the arch, and horizontal green-purple stripes across the lower film. The striped bands slowly drift and change spacing, while magenta blotches near the top deform and shift position gradually. The outer curvature of the dome also changes subtly, showing a slow rearrangement of the thin surface. A dark silhouette reflection remains on the left side of the film, and a dark vertical shape stays near the right edge. The Buddha head remains fixed in position, size, and luminous appearance throughout the excerpt.
